evals.prompt: Build a full-stack SaaS task management web app with PostgreSQL, NextAuth, and a React dashboard.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator generates a plan DAG using the SaaS profile, running core-repo-discovery first, followed by database migrations, backend services, UI components, auth, and quality gates.
expectations: The orchestrator creates .agent/context/plan.md with DAG vertical slices
The first slice invokes core-repo-discovery to determine repository context
The execution sequence routes schema changes to database-migrations-orm before backend-service
Quality release gate is invoked in step mode after each vertical slice

evals.prompt: Fix a failing database connection error and update the authentication middleware tokens.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator identifies change signals for database and auth files, routing to core-debugging, database-migrations-orm, and auth-authentication with human approval check for CRITICAL auth operations.
expectations: The orchestrator routes auth middleware modifications to auth-authentication and security-secure-coding
The status report lists REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW for authentication token changes
Failed steps are routed to core-debugging with a maximum of 2 remediation cycles

evals.prompt: Refactor the user profile page components and update UI styling.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator routes frontend TSX changes through frontend-accessibility, testing-e2e-browser, and uiux-design-critique.
expectations: The change signals for TSX/CSS files trigger frontend-accessibility and testing-e2e-browser
Risk level for frontend UI component edits is classified as LOW or MEDIUM
Final execution status is reported using the standard five statuses
